messages.author: 54e558ac5e7786c2
messages.subject: categorical data
parts:
Hello all:

Mine is a two part question. I'm trying to analyze categorical data in
a cross between inbred mice. All the individuals fall into two
classes, nonaffected (classified phenotypically as "0") and affected
(classified as a quantitative variable normally distributed). My
first question is what is the best QTL model to use to analyze thesee
data? Secondly, R/qtl reads the variable as a factor. How can I
convert a variable from a factor to a numeric classification?

Thanks for your help,
Charles

messages.author: 094359a3211991a2
messages.subject: Re: categorical data
parts:
I think the answer to your first question is
scanone(x, model="2part", upper=F)

messages.author: ab8dbe3bec292afe
messages.subject: Re: categorical data
parts:
Also, to convert a phenotype from a factor to numeric, you can
type something like

mycross$pheno[,5] <- as.numeric(mycross$pheno[,5])

(for the 5th phenotype).

karl
